title: Resolution urging Albany to fully exempt poorest senior homeowners from property tax
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, legislation letting New York City give a full property tax exemption to homeowners who qualify for the Senior Citizen Homeowners' Exemption and whose only income is Social Security. Under current law these homeowners can get at most a 50 percent exemption despite having annual household income of $58,399 or less. The resolution argues a full exemption would ease housing costs for older New Yorkers living on fixed incomes.
